title: Serve
intro: We believe Christian faith is lived out through practical care for our neighbors and our community.

sections.heading: Laundry Love
sections.text: Laundry Love helps neighbors with the practical cost of washing and drying clothes. This ministry is one way Epiphany meets people with dignity and care.

sections.heading: Blood Drive
sections.text: Our parish hosts a community blood drive and invites neighbors, friends, and members to take part in a simple act that can save lives.

sections.heading: Other outreach
sections.text: Use the ministry section below for current outreach projects and opportunities to help.
